features.description: Baseline: feat/audio-0.6 in a fresh ailang-packages clone; compat_test.ail pins (reference recipes + 8 short recipes covering every 0.5.0 field) rendered by the published 0.5.0 and frozen; strict-VM probe of scatterAdd, record-carrying constructors and Leaf(Leaf); timing baseline re-run; game base prints 41 sounds
acceptance_criteria: ailang test --package $PKG passes with compat_test.ail on 0.5.0 code; the pins' commit hash is recorded here as AR0
the strict-VM probe result for scatterAdd, a record-carrying constructor and Leaf(Leaf) is recorded; any failure is reported with ailang messages (GCP store) and the design fallback chosen
on BASE (after #344): make sound-synth-check prints '41 sounds regenerate byte for byte' (stop and report otherwise)

features.description: filter module: SvfMode, Band, svfGain (closed form), svf, svfSweep, bank, vowelBands (Peterson and Barney F1-F3); tests red first
acceptance_criteria: band-pass 1 kHz Q 2: 0.00 dB +-0.02 at 1 kHz, -10.014 / -10.056 dB +-0.05 at 500 Hz / 2 kHz
svfGain equals the measured gain on 20 seeded cases within 0.05 dB; LP + BP/Q + HP reconstructs the input to 1e-9; a fixed sweep equals svf bit for bit
ailang check --package $PKG, ailang test --package $PKG and ailang pkg quality --no-run $PKG (no gates) pass

features.description: noise: pinkOf (Kellet refined) and brownOf (onePole 20 Hz, closed-form RMS scale); Goertzel PSD-slope test
acceptance_criteria: PSD slope over 93.75-3000 Hz (24 Hann segments of 4096): white 0, pink -3.01, brown -6.02 dB/octave, each +-0.5
RMS of pink and brown within 10% of 1/sqrt(3); same seed same samples, another seed different
white and rampNoise outputs unchanged (existing pins pass); a 1 s pink loop's seam <= max step + 1

features.description: osc module: sawSamples (polyBLEP, glide, vibrato, seeded jitter), fmIndexAt/fmSamples (2-op phase modulation), pluckPeriod/pluckSamples (Karplus-Strong, blocked delay line, allpass tuning)
acceptance_criteria: saw 1 kHz harmonics 1-5 within 0.5 dB of 2/(pi k); the 1.6 kHz alias of a 3.1 kHz saw >= 20 dB below a naive saw
FM fc 2400, ratio 0.25, constant index: lines k = 0..3 equal |J_k(1)| and |J_k(2)| within 0.002; index 0 equals a sine to 1e-12
pluck tuned fundamental within 1 cent at 110, 440 and 1046.5 Hz; untuned within 0.5 cent of rate/(N+0.5); T60 within 10%
the blocked pluck equals a per-sample Array-ring reference bit for bit

features.description: sound front end: recipe.finish (verbatim move), Sound/Part/Leaf/Extra/SoundLimits, parseSoundsAs/parseSounds/parseSoundsChecked, validateSound, soundLoopErrors, soundFrames, classicOnly, renderSound (Classic delegation), renderSoundChecked
acceptance_criteria: the AR0 compat pins and the reference loop pin pass before and after recipe.finish, through render and renderSound
parseRecipes refuses every 0.6 key and names parseSounds; parseSounds accepts them; an unknown key is still refused
every loop rule of design §D7 has a named 'loop: ...' test
renderSoundChecked refuses over-budget events and work before allocating samples

features.description: events module (scatterStarts jittered grid, fixedStarts, place with wrap, variation) and the events layer in sound (one-shot voices, depth 1)
acceptance_criteria: an event starting at n - 100 puts its first 100 samples at the end and the rest at the start, exactly
a loop of events has analysis.seam <= max step + 1; scatter starts are in [0, n), keep min_gap, number exactly count, repeat for a seed
non-overlapping events sum linearly (1e-9); a one-shot cuts and fades an event past its end; vary.cents moves sources, not filters

features.description: space module (Schroeder 4 combs + 2 allpasses with Moorer damping, pre-delay, wet) and the layer space stage; cut line to 0.7.0 if the sprint passes day 7 first
acceptance_criteria: a comb's impulse response is g^k at multiples of d exactly; each allpass's impulse-response energy is 1 within 1e-9
measured T60 (backward integration -5 to -35 dB) within 5% of t60 with damping off; wet 0 returns the input bit for bit
a loop with space keeps a clean seam over 1 + ceil(t60/seconds) periods; more than 5 periods is refused
